source: NOAA ETOPO 2022 v1 15 arc-second surface elevation
sourceVerticalReference: EGM2008 height where encoded by EPSG:9518; retained as source metadata and not assumed equal to canonical DEM vertical datum
role: derived broad seabed/terrain basis; not a 1940s sounding survey and not a sea-surface datum
